description: Puts out a trigger or a gate when the voltage at CV IN matches a chosen note

params.text: Picks the note to match, through the twelve semitones from C to B
Picks the octave to match, from -1 to 8, with C4 at 0V; turned fully counter-clockwise it reads All, and the note matches in every octave

inputs.text: The voltage tested against the chosen note; with nothing patched here the output stays at 0V
In the clocked output modes, only a rising edge here can produce a trigger or gate

outputs.text: Carries 10V when the incoming voltage matches the chosen note, as a trigger or a gate

menu: Output Mode — Trigger, Gate, Clocked Trigger or Clocked Gate
Trigger Length — how long the trigger pulse lasts, from 1ms to 200ms
Tolerance Level — how far the incoming voltage may stray from the note and be taken as a match, from Exact (0) to Very Coarse (0.5)
Notation — Sharp or Flat, setting how the readout names a black note

inputs.0: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
